relics.name: The Spy's Monocle
relics.description: See the top card of the deck at all times.
relics.effect: Continuously reveals the top card of the draw pile to the player.
relics.flavorText: One eye on the cards, one eye on the exits.
synergies: Peek ability chains for deep deck knowledge
Helps plan defense by knowing what's coming

relics.name: The Iron Gauntlet
relics.description: Your first attack each bout ignores the rank-matching rule.
relics.effect: The first card played as an attack in each bout bypasses the rank-match restriction, allowing any rank.
relics.flavorText: Subtlety is for those who lack strength.
synergies: DoubleTrouble for explosive openers
PileOn to stack pressure after the free attack

relics.name: The Two-Faced Coin
relics.description: Once per match, draw 1 fewer card during a refill phase.
relics.effect: Activates once per match: during a card refill at bout end, the player draws 1 fewer card than normal.
relics.flavorText: Heads I win, tails you lose. Standard Venetian contract.
synergies: TrumpChanger to maintain trump advantage with a smaller hand
Deflect plays better with precise hand control

relics.name: The Bottomless Purse
relics.description: At match start, rearrange the bottom 3 cards of the deck.
relics.effect: Before the first bout, peek at and reorder the bottom 3 cards in the draw pile.
relics.flavorText: There's always one more coin. One more card. One more trick.
synergies: CardCounter for complete late-game knowledge
EndgameSpecialist to ensure strong finishers are last

relics.name: Scholar's Lens
relics.description: At match start, reveal 3 random cards in the opponent's hand.
relics.effect: When the match begins, 3 cards chosen at random from the opponent's starting hand are revealed to the player.
relics.flavorText: Knowledge is never free, but it's always worth the price.
synergies: Spy's Monocle for layered information advantage
Feint plays are stronger when you know what they hold

relics.name: Venetian Cipher
relics.description: After successfully defending a bout, see the next 2 cards you will draw.
relics.effect: When the player wins a bout as defender (all attacks beaten), reveal the top 2 cards of the draw pile until the player draws them.
relics.flavorText: The Doge's private correspondence, decoded by a man who no longer exists.
synergies: Blocker for reliable defensive wins that trigger the peek
SeizeInitiative to act on the information gained

relics.name: The Forger's Kit
relics.description: Abilities that bind to 1 card now bind to 2.
relics.effect: During match setup, any ability with a binding count of 1 is treated as binding count 2, doubling the chances of drawing an ability card.
relics.flavorText: With the right tools, any man can become a cardinal. Or a king.
synergies: Any single-bind ability doubles in consistency
Schemer abilities like Peek and Blocker become far more reliable

relics.name: The Duelist's Glove
relics.description: When the opponent picks up your attacks, draw 1 extra card.
relics.effect: Whenever the opponent eats (picks up all attack cards in a bout), the player draws 1 additional card during the next refill.
relics.flavorText: A slap across the face. An insult that demands satisfaction.
synergies: PileOn to force more pickups
DoubleTrouble for overwhelming attacks that compound draws

relics.name: Poisoned Wine
relics.description: When the opponent eats your attacks, they draw 2 extra from the deck.
relics.effect: Whenever the opponent picks up attack cards (eats), they must draw 2 additional cards from the draw pile.
relics.flavorText: A toast to your health. Drink deep.
synergies: Duelist's Glove for double punishment on pickups
Brute archetype perk Fury for triple compound effect

relics.name: Warhammer Pommel
relics.description: Your trump attacks count as 1 rank higher for defense purposes.
relics.effect: When the player plays a trump card as an attack, the defender must beat it as though it were 1 rank higher than printed.
relics.flavorText: The Condottiero's argument-ender. No rhetoric required.
synergies: TrumpAffinity for devastating trump-based pressure
Works against Trickster defensive trump plays

relics.name: The Heretic's Brand
relics.description: Opponent's trump cards are treated as 1 rank lower for defense.
relics.effect: All trump cards in the opponent's hand are treated as 1 rank lower when used to defend, making their trump defenses weaker.
relics.flavorText: Marked by the Inquisition. Not even the saints will save you now.
synergies: Warhammer Pommel for total trump dominance
Forces opponents to burn high trumps on medium attacks

relics.name: The Alchemist's Stone
relics.description: Choose the trump suit at match start.
relics.effect: Before the match begins, the player selects which of the 4 suits will be trump for the entire match.
relics.flavorText: Base metals into gold. Losing hands into winning ones. It's all transmutation.
synergies: Check your starting hand, pick the suit you hold most of
TrumpChanger ability becomes insurance rather than necessity

relics.name: Masquerade Mask
relics.description: Once per match, play a non-trump card as though it were trump suit.
relics.effect: Once per match, the player may designate one card they play (attack or defense) to be treated as trump suit for that play only. Does not change the card permanently.
relics.flavorText: Behind the mask, everyone is someone else. Even the cards.
synergies: Deflect for a devastating surprise redirect
Saves a losing defense once per match

relics.name: The Courtesan's Fan
relics.description: Once per match, force the opponent to attack with their lowest-rank card.
relics.effect: Activates once per match during an opponent's attack phase: the opponent's next attack must use their lowest-rank card in hand.
relics.flavorText: She fans herself, and the Duke does whatever she wishes.
synergies: Blocker to guarantee a successful defense against the forced weak attack
SeizeInitiative to reclaim tempo after the forced weak bout

relics.name: Crown of Thorns
relics.description: Trump cards played in defense qualify for next bout's rank-matching.
relics.effect: When the player defends with a trump card, that trump card's rank is remembered and qualifies for rank-match attacks in the following bout.
relics.flavorText: Suffering sanctifies. Every wound becomes a weapon.
synergies: Alchemist's Stone ensures plentiful trump for defense chains
Masquerade Mask creates phantom rank-match setups

relics.name: The Merchant's Purse
relics.description: +3 Florins after each match victory.
relics.effect: Whenever the player wins a match, gain 3 bonus Florins in addition to the normal match reward.
relics.flavorText: A Florentine purse: always heavier than it looks, always lighter than you'd like.
synergies: Snowballs with consistent wins
Funds shop purchases for Hoarder's large hand strategy

relics.name: The Miser's Ring
relics.description: +1 Florin for each bout you successfully defend.
relics.effect: Each time the player wins a bout as the defender (all attacks beaten), gain 1 Florin. Rewards accumulate across all bouts in the match.
relics.flavorText: Count every coin. Count every card. Count every breath your enemies take.
synergies: Blocker and DoubleDefense for reliable defense-triggered income
Defensive playstyle funds larger purchases

relics.name: The Shield Brooch
relics.description: Once per match, automatically beat the first undefended attack.
relics.effect: The first time the player cannot beat an attack card during defense, the Shield Brooch activates and automatically counters that one card. Consumed after one use per match.
relics.flavorText: The Medici crest. Even their jewelry is armor.
synergies: Buys time for Hoarder's late-game scaling
Pairs with large hand to ensure you rarely eat

relics.name: The Tailor's Thimble
relics.description: Starting hand size reduced to 5, but draw 1 extra each refill.
relics.effect: Match begins with 5 cards instead of 6. At each bout refill, draw 1 additional card beyond the normal amount.
relics.flavorText: Measure twice, cut once. Hold less, but never run dry.
synergies: Hoarder builds that want consistent refills
Schemer scrying benefits from seeing more fresh cards

relics.name: Quicksilver Vial
relics.description: Once per match, use an ability without discarding the bound card.
relics.effect: The first ability activation each match does not require discarding the card that triggered it. The card remains in hand after the ability resolves.
relics.flavorText: Liquid silver, liquid time. The alchemists say it captures moments.
synergies: High-value abilities like Gambit or SeizeInitiative become safer
Forger's Kit means more chances to trigger this on the right card

relics.name: The Phoenix Medal
relics.description: If you would lose the run, restore 1 Prestige instead. Once per run.
relics.effect: When the player's Prestige would drop to 0 (run over), set Prestige to 1 instead. This relic is consumed after use and cannot trigger again.
relics.flavorText: The Order of the Phoenix. From the ashes, the gambler rises.
synergies: Safety net for aggressive builds that risk more losses
Lets you take harder map paths without fear

relics.name: Fool's Gold
relics.description: Start each match with a temporary 7 of the trump suit.
relics.effect: At match start, a virtual card (rank 7, trump suit) is added to the player's hand. This card is removed from the game at end of match.
relics.flavorText: Glitters like the real thing. Gone before they notice.
synergies: Guaranteed trump card works with Trickster trump manipulation
Extra card in hand benefits Hoarder attrition strategy

relics.name: The Devil's Bargain
relics.description: At match start, choose: +5 Florins OR start with 1 fewer card.
relics.effect: Before each match, the player is presented a choice: gain 5 Florins immediately, or reduce starting hand by 1 card for this match only.
relics.flavorText: The contract is simple. The fine print is eternal.
synergies: Economy option fuels expensive shop builds
Hand reduction option combos with Tailor's Thimble extra draws

relics.name: The Scholar's Tome
relics.description: +1 ability slot (6 max instead of 5).
relics.effect: Permanently increases the player's maximum ability slots from 5 to 6. Takes effect immediately upon acquisition.
relics.flavorText: In the library of San Marco, every book is a weapon. This one is a siege engine.
synergies: More abilities means more cards bound, stronger overall toolkit
Schemer benefits most with more ability triggers to plan around

relics.name: The Ventriloquist's Dummy
relics.description: Once per match, use one of the opponent's abilities as your own.
relics.effect: Once per match, when the player could use an ability, they may instead activate an ability bound to a card in the opponent's hand (if known) or a random opponent ability.
relics.flavorText: Who is the puppet, and who pulls the strings? In Venice, the answer changes hourly.
synergies: Scholar's Lens to see which opponent abilities to steal
Devastating against elite opponents with powerful abilities

relics.name: The Juggler's Balls
relics.description: After the first bout, discard 1 card for free.
relics.effect: At the end of the first bout, the player may choose 1 card from their hand to discard without penalty. Helps sculpt the hand for later bouts.
relics.flavorText: Keep three in the air and the crowd never notices the fourth up your sleeve.
synergies: Dump a useless suit for a tighter hand
Schemer scrying helps identify which card to toss

relics.name: Condottiero's Sash
relics.description: +1 max attack per bout (7 instead of 6).
relics.effect: The maximum number of attack cards that can be played in a single bout increases by 1.
relics.flavorText: The mercenary general counts victories, not casualties.
synergies: PileOn for massive bout-ending volleys
DoubleTrouble openers leave room for more follow-up attacks

relics.name: The Glass Eye
relics.description: At match start, know the trump suit before seeing your hand.
relics.effect: The trump suit is revealed to the player before the initial hand is dealt. In modes where trump is hidden, this overrides that concealment.
relics.flavorText: It sees nothing, yet somehow its owner sees everything.
synergies: Plan your opening strategy around known trump
Counters NoTrumpsBeforeDusk house rule by providing advance knowledge

Common.description: Small, reliable effects. Easy to acquire, never regrettable.

Uncommon.description: Meaningful effects that shape playstyle. Worth building around.

Rare.description: Build-defining relics. Can warp strategy around their effect.

designNotes.slotTension: With 5 relic slots, players must constantly evaluate which relics serve their evolving strategy. A Brute who finds Alchemist's Stone faces a genuine dilemma: is trump control worth a slot in an aggro build?
designNotes.comboPaths: Relics are designed with 2-3 natural combo partners each, creating discovery moments. Scholar's Lens + Ventriloquist's Dummy = know and steal opponent abilities. Heretic's Brand + Warhammer Pommel = total trump dominance.
designNotes.economyBalance: Economy relics (Merchant's Purse, Miser's Ring, Devil's Bargain) compete with combat relics for slots. Taking economy early funds better shop purchases but weakens immediate match power.
designNotes.doctrineBleed: Universal relics intentionally synergize across doctrines. Quicksilver Vial benefits everyone but especially ability-heavy Schemers. Shield Brooch helps everyone but especially slow-starting Hoarders.
